purpose: Deterministic deny rules for shell commands spawned by the Maestro runtime. Prompt-level bans (SKILL.md) are advisory; this policy is enforced in code before spawn. Each rule has an id, a description, and test evidence in tests/policy-enforcer.test.js.

rules.description: Forbid git push from automated verification/execution (only a human-led explicit flow may push).
Forbid git commit from automated verification/execution.
Forbid unattended full-auto flags in high-risk operations.
Forbid recursive removal of filesystem roots, home, or with --no-preserve-root.
Forbid service-role credentials inline in spawned commands.
Forbid curl/wget piped directly into a shell.
